title: Published Added-Name Billing Schedule
content:
# Published added-name billing schedule

*SSL/TLS Certificates — the part of the term for which a name added to a multi-domain certificate subscription is billed*

The part of the term an added name is billed for follows this schedule, and no added name is ever billed beyond the subscription end date. "Days remaining" means the calendar days from today to the subscription end date. "Prorated" means the added name's yearly price multiplied by the days remaining and divided by 365. The per-name part is rounded half up to the cent.

| Remaining term on the day the name is added | Per-name part |
|---|---|
| 90 days or fewer remain | the prorated amount, but never less than the minimum added-name charge of 9.99 |
| more than 90 days remain, and the term line the name is billed into is a renewal or auto-renew line that has not begun yet | the prorated amount, but never more than the yearly price multiplied by the number of years that line covers; the days before that renewal begins are covered free |
| more than 90 days remain, in any other case | the prorated amount |

The term line the name is billed into is the subscription's purchase, renewal or auto-renew charge line whose period ends on the subscription end date, the latest by charge date where several do. A renewal or auto-renew line has not begun yet when its period start lies after today.

## Conditions of the schedule

- **Short remaining term.** At 90 days remaining the minimum of 9.99 applies; at 91 days remaining it does not, and the prorated amount stands.
- **Renewal not yet begun.** The upper limit applies only where more than 90 days remain and the line the name is billed into is a renewal or auto-renew line whose period starts after today. Where that line is the purchase line, or a renewal line whose period has already started, the prorated amount stands with no upper limit.

## Hypothetical figures

All figures below are illustrations, using a yearly price of 14.99 for the added name.

1. 47 days remain. Prorated: 14.99 multiplied by 47 and divided by 365 is about 1.93, which is below the minimum, so the per-name part is 9.99.
2. 91 days remain on a purchase line. Prorated: about 3.737, rounded half up to 3.74; no minimum applies.
3. 223 days remain and the current term line began last year. Prorated: about 9.158, rounded half up to 9.16.
4. 412 days remain, and the name is billed into a 1-year renewal line whose period starts 47 days from today. Prorated: about 16.920; the limit is 14.99 multiplied by 1 year, that is 14.99, so the per-name part is 14.99 and the 47 days before the renewal begins are covered free.
